blocks.text: AI Governance Maturity Assessment
A free self-assessment that scores your organization's AI governance maturity, level 0 to 4, across 6 pillars: accountability, transparency, risk, data, lifecycle, and oversight.
What This Assessment Measures

Most companies assume they have AI governance because a policy document exists somewhere. This assessment checks whether that policy is actually practiced: whether every AI system has a named owner, whether use cases get tiered by real harm, whether a person can genuinely override a production system, not just in theory.

You will answer 12 short questions across six pillars, two per pillar. Each answer maps to a maturity level from 0 (Ad Hoc) to 4 (Optimizing). Your overall score and a pillar-by-pillar breakdown appear as soon as you finish, along with the specific next step for your weakest areas. No email required.
Find Your AI Governance Maturity Level
